facts.fact: The 2026 finance law (decree 26-003/PR of 16 January 2026) appropriates KMF 114 001 360 to the Secrétariat Général (service 09 0902) of the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy, including a KMF 50 000 000 investment line paid by the state with no donor share.

facts.fact: The service rose from KMF 17 546 005 in the 2025 rectificative finance law to KMF 114 001 360 in the 2026 finance law (budget years 2025 and 2026), about 6.5 times; the document says the digital spend in the service is not separable.
facts.system: Ministère des Postes, des Télécommunications et de l'Économie Numérique, Secrétariat Général budget, 2026

facts.fact: The 2026 finance law (decree 26-003/PR of 16 January 2026) appropriates KMF 50 000 000, wholly as a transfer, to the chambre du Numérique (service 09 0910, under the digital ministry).

The line fell from KMF 73 000 000 in the 2025 rectificative law to KMF 50 000 000 in the 2026 law (budget years 2025 and 2026), minus 31.5%; the document notes this and another body's line look swapped between the years and cannot tell a real cut from a transcription swap.

facts.fact: The FY2025 finance law (decree 24-186/PR of 19 December 2024) appropriates KMF 9,128,000 (salaries 6,128,000, goods and services 3,000,000) for the Direction Generale de l'informatique, the state's computing directorate in the finance ministry; the FY2026 volume shows the 2025 rectificative cut it to KMF 0.

The directorate's appropriation is KMF 9,128,000 in the 2025 law and the same KMF 9,128,000 in the 2024 rectified column (LFR 2024), so the later year is the same; the FY2025 rectificative then revised 2025 to KMF 0.

note: Budget line record; the FY2025 original and the 2024 comparator are equal, which the study rule files as fell.

facts.fact: The FY2025 finance law (decree 24-186/PR of 19 December 2024) appropriates KMF 73,000,000, wholly as a transfer (subvention), to the chambre du Numerique under the posts, telecommunications and digital economy ministry; the amount was unchanged by the 2025 rectificative.

note: No rose/fell: the record calls the body new in FY2025 yet prints a 73,000,000 comparator for 2024, which is unclear.
A common-expenditure nature line (website and internet consumption, cut KMF 45m to 15m by virement within 2024), not a digital ministry, agency or programme, and not a two-year comparison; no fact.

Funds the regulator ANRTIC by a turnover levy, licence-fee share and sanctions share; income of a regulator that no law assigns to digital programmes is class other, and no universal service fund is created; no fact.

facts.fact: Finance law 23-019/AU (adopted 27 November 2023) appropriates KMF 194,457,800 for 2024 to the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy, with no capital; the August 2024 rectificative revised it to KMF 682,681,240.
facts.system: Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy, budget 2024

facts.fact: The ministry's 2024 appropriation of KMF 194,457,800 is lower than the 2023 rectified figure of KMF 337,232,800 (down KMF 142,775,000, 42.34%), as printed in the law.
facts.system: Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy, budget 2024

facts.fact: The FY2024 budget execution report of 14 March 2025 shows the ministry spent KMF 183,586,075 in 2024 (salaries 41,223,675; goods and services 2,362,400; transfers 140,000,000), 94.41% of the original appropriation and 26.89% of the revised KMF 682,681,240.
